note: Atomic spectra through the spectral viewer (GAME_SPEC §12.5, §13.7, Stage 85; docs/CURRICULUM.md, experiment 54): four discharge lamps (hydrogen, helium, mercury, neon), each its gas's lines (NIST's), and the spectral viewer. Hydrogen's visible lines are Balmer's: 1/lambda = R (1/4 - 1/n^2), n = 3, 4, 5, 6; two of them give the Rydberg constant.
